name: Compiled
tagline: Sixty tech sources, scraped concurrently, deduplicated three ways, served from SQLite.
summary: A news aggregator that fetches sixty tech blogs and news sites behind a semaphore with exponential backoff, parses feeds and listing pages with BeautifulSoup, deduplicates by canonical URL, title fingerprint and token-set Jaccard similarity, scores thirteen categories from weighted keyword tables, and serves the result through a FastAPI REST API and a dependency-free web UI on SQLite with FTS5 search. Dockerised and running on Fly.io, refreshing itself every twenty minutes.

data.angle: Sixty sources fetched concurrently behind a semaphore with backoff, three-pass dedupe (canonical URL, title fingerprint, Jaccard above 0.85), idempotent WAL upserts, FTS5 search and keyset pagination.

swe.angle: An async Python 3.12 service on FastAPI and httpx with 108 tests, a Dockerfile, a health check, and a Fly.io deployment that refreshes itself every twenty minutes.

ml.angle: Near-duplicate detection by token-set Jaccard similarity inside a two-day window, and weighted keyword scoring across thirteen categories, with the thresholds written down and tested.

highlights: One AsyncClient fetches every source behind a semaphore; timeouts, 5xx and 429 retry with exponential backoff, 4xx is recorded and not retried, and a broken source never fails the run.
Bodies stream and cap at 25 MB, redirects at five hops, and the User-Agent names the crawler honestly.
The surviving duplicate prefers the original publisher and the earliest timestamp; the other sources are kept in also_seen_on and the highest vote count seen on any copy carries over.
UNIQUE constraints on canonical URL and title fingerprint make a repeated scrape idempotent; a stored article is never replaced.
Retention pruning and an in-process scheduler keep a 1 GB volume honest without a second service.
